faq.question: Do I need a trademark for Amazon Brand Registry?
faq.answer: Yes. Amazon Brand Registry generally requires an eligible registered or pending trademark from a recognized trademark office. Country-specific rules apply. We review your current status and the practical path to enrollment during the free audit.

faq.question: Do you file trademarks as a law firm?
faq.answer: No. We provide process guidance and Brand Registry application support for sellers. When attorney representation is required, we discuss that during scoping rather than presenting agency support as legal counsel.

faq.question: How long does Brand Registry enrollment take?
faq.answer: Timelines depend on trademark status and Amazon review. Enrollment is typically faster when a qualifying trademark record already exists and brand details match Amazon requirements. We do not guarantee approval timelines.

faq.question: What can I unlock after Brand Registry approval?
faq.answer: Common unlocks include A+ Content, Brand Stores, and brand protection tools. Exact features depend on Amazon program availability for your account and marketplace.

faq.question: Can you help if my Brand Registry application was rejected?
faq.answer: Yes. We review rejection reasons, documentation gaps, and brand detail mismatches, then outline corrective next steps. Outcomes still depend on Amazon and trademark office review.

faq.question: Is Brand Registry only useful for large brands?
faq.answer: No. Growing sellers benefit from protection tools and enhanced content earlier, especially before scaling advertising and catalog size.

faq.question: Which Amazon marketplaces do you support?
faq.answer: We support Brand Registry and related brand-setup work for catalogs selling across official Amazon Seller Central marketplaces: United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Sweden, Poland, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, South Africa, India, Japan, Australia, and Singapore. Trademark office requirements are country-specific; scope is confirmed during your audit consultation.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Submit the free audit form or contact us at +1 (360) 660-1210 or info@ecomgliders.com. Typical next steps are a readiness review, trademark pathway plan, then Brand Registry enrollment support.
